# v6 step 1: bottleneck statistics (4x4, fault-free; generated by bottleneck_v6.py)

Averages over seeds 101-103. DeFT_tm = DEFT_LB proxy with DeFT_tm(rho*)'s LUT (traffic-identical to DeFT_tm).

## Head-flit waiting per hop, by router class (cycles)

resid = input-buffer residence of a head flit (arrival in the buffer to forwarding); front = wait at the buffer front (routing, arbitration, credits) until forwarding. Per hop = per router traversal.

## Where the entry decision is fixed (interposer)

"remaining hops" = interposer hops still to go to the chosen entry VL when only one candidate was left (0 = fixed by taking the VL while others were open; -1 = fixed before the interposer, e.g. a fixed pair). "after k interposer hops" = interposer hops already travelled at that moment.
